Open Web UI — the LLM chat front-end — on the CachyOS (x86_64_v3) base,
with its auto-configuring entrypoint and the open-webui 0.12.3 release
from PyPI through pixi. Composes agent-forwarding (GPG/SSH/direnv for the
forwarded-agent workflow) and pod-dbus, the same three candies the Fedora
box uses, so the two images differ only by base distro. The service is
supervisord-managed on port 8080 and reaches LLM providers through the
entrypoint's env/secrets projection.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-agent-forwarding:v2026.274.0608`
- `@github.com/opencharly/pod-openwebui:v2026.293.1944`
- `@github.com/opencharly/pod-dbus:v2026.274.0648`
